title: AgiBot humanoid platform
summary: Chinese general-purpose humanoid maker spun out of a robotics incubator, targeting light assembly.
bodyHtml:
What This Is

AgiBot, also known as Zhiyuan Robotics, builds general-purpose humanoids and has run demonstrations of coordinated multi-robot tasks in simulated and real settings. It emerged from a Shanghai robotics ecosystem with strong local government backing and has attracted attention for rapid iteration on hardware. Production volume and reliability data remain limited.

Status

Attribute Value
Development stage Pilot
Estimated window 2025–2028
Confidence label Researching
Evidence Editorial synthesis of company, agency and press reporting
Compiled 18 November 2026

Related records

Investment Exposure

A crowded field where the differentiator will be uptime and task success rates, not demo videos.

What Would Change The View

  • Paid deployments and repeat orders.
  • Task success rates outside demos.
  • Funding runway through the hardware price war.

Record Notes

Editorial brief, not an imported source note. Named milestones are drawn from company, agency and press reporting; forward dates are announced targets, not verified outcomes. No figure here is an audited statistic.
